name: moodboard-reader
description: Searches and reads Cosmos (cosmos.so), the visual inspiration library: images, GIFs and videos by meaning, public collections and profiles, and your own private collections when signed in. Read-only.

username.title: Cosmos email or username
username.description: Signs in, so Claude can read your own collections, private ones included. Leave empty for public content only.

password.title: Cosmos password
password.description: Kept in your system's secure storage. Leave empty for public content only.
